plans.idea: Classic top-to-bottom skyscraper story: brand lockup caps the column, then a tall readable text block (headline over the benefit list), the bottle as the visual pause, the 'Taste the Difference' pill as the closing action, and legal tucked at the foot, all on one centred axis.

Product-first: the orange bottle leads at the top as the eye-catcher, the headline and benefits read beneath it in the tallest block, then the pill and a signature brand lockup close the column above the legal line.

Message-then-proof: a dominant half-height copy block with the 'Taste the Difference' pill locked directly under it as one grouped message unit, then the bottle filling the lower third as a visual sign-off, with the brand lockup and legal sharing a quiet footer.
